relevance.why: Haji pays for Claude Max and builds production apps; swapping Claude Code's model for free open models trades away the model quality that makes the workflow work. Useful only as a cheap overflow/secondary-task backend, same niche as the liked OmniRoute and NVIDIA free endpoints

implement_score.why: An hour to try as a fallback for low-stakes tasks when Max limits hit; not for main development. Risk: proxying Claude Code to third-party providers may conflict with Claude Code terms, and free tiers change

gap.what: Near-duplicate of liked OmniRoute (free-tier chaining across ~350 models) and NVIDIA free endpoints; adds only the specific repo name free-claude-code and its '50 providers / 1.3B tokens' framing

verify: Does the repo actually have ~48k stars and is it maintained (Python 3.14 badge suggests very recent)?
Which 50 providers and what real daily caps; '1.3B tokens/month' is a sum of free tiers, not a usable budget
Does routing Claude Code through a third-party proxy violate Anthropic's Claude Code terms?
Quality claim is unsupported: free models are not Opus/Fable-class
